source:
@@U00468@@
If all this nonsense meets your requirements, let's get on with the farce.

@@U00470@@
Yes, well, blood is a very special juice.

@@U00472@@
You needn't worry. ’m not about to break our bargain! Never to give up striving with all my energy is what I promise. I aimed too high. I’m only fit to be with the likes of you. The great Spirit rejects me, Nature shuts her gates against me, the thread of thought is snapped, and for ages now I've loathed the blight of knowledge. Let us satisfy our passions in the throws of sensuality. Surround me with your wonders and I'll never ask to know what’s behind them. Let us plunge ourselves into the roar of time, the maelstrom of chance, hit or miss, pain or pleasure, however it comes, never ceasing, always doing. There’s no other way.

@@U00474@@
Youre free. Do as you please. No restrictions. Every delight is yours for the taking, every pleasure yours to be snatched at will. And may they agree with you. Just be certain of one thing: Be bold. Take what you want!
translation:
@@U00468@@
如果这些废话都符合你的要求，那我们就继续闹剧吧。

@@U00470@@
是的，血液是一种非常特殊的汁液。

@@U00472@@
你不用担心。我不会破坏我们的约定！我承诺，永不放弃，尽全力奋斗。我的目标太高了。我只适合和你这样的人在一起。伟大的精神拒绝了我，大自然对我关闭了大门，思想的线索被折断了，多年来我一直厌恶知识的枯萎。让我们在感官享受中满足我们的激情。用你的奇迹包围我，我永远不会问他们背后是什么。让我们投入时间的咆哮，机遇的漩涡，命中或错过，痛苦或快乐，无论它如何来，永不停歇，永远在做。没有其他办法。

@@U00474@@
你自由了。随你便吧。没有限制。每一种快乐都是你可以获取的，每一种快乐都是你可以随意夺取的。愿他们同意你的观点。只要确定一件事：大胆。拿走你想要的吧！
